audit.whatIsWrong: Final Hour is never mentioned anywhere in the entry, and phases[4].why writes 'Between the Worlds' while calling 6 your window.
audit.why: Final Hour (100s at rank 1 down to 70s) gives her INVISIBILITY during Tumble and cuts Tumble's cooldown — Tumble is already 6s at rank 1 and 2s maxed. So her level 6 turns her into something that vanishes mid-trade, which is the opposite of the free all-in the entry promises at 6. Aurora's ultimate is Between Worlds.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names both ultimates and states the Tumble invisibility.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry calls Condemn a stun in four places with no condition, and says Silver Bolts needs 'three straight autos'.
audit.why: Condemn (E, 20s at rank 1 down to 12s, 550 range) knocks you back; it only stuns if the knockback lands you against terrain. Away from a wall it is displacement, not lockdown — so where you stand decides whether her cooldown is scary. And Silver Bolts counts the third consecutive attack OR ABILITY on the same target, so her Q and E advance the stack too; 'three straight autos' undercounts how fast the true damage arrives.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block rebuilt on Condemn's terrain condition with the real 20s, and the abilities-count rule for Silver Bolts stated.
